# EDGAR Terminal

EDGAR Terminal is a free, accountless SEC filings explorer for public-company research.

Live site: https://secedgarterminal.com/

## Paid SEC Snapshot API

The paid endpoint returns a compact JSON snapshot of public SEC filing metadata for a requested ticker. It is designed for scripts, agents, and research workflows that need source-linked public SEC records.

Endpoint:

GET https://secedgarterminal.com/api/paid/snapshot?ticker=AAPL

Price:

0.001 SOL on Solana mainnet.

ScoutGate x402 proxy:

- Proxy endpoint: https://x402-scoutgate.onrender.com/api/2f9ca2f9?ticker=AAPL
- x402Scout catalog search: https://x402scout.com/catalog?q=EDGAR
- Price: 0.01 USDC on Base through ScoutGate.
- Registered payout address for settlement tracking: 0x91D59f9932557c8347AaAC800756E49A1cEDc794
- Settlement note: ScoutGate returns a platform-mediated x402 challenge. Treat the challenge payTo address as ScoutGate-controlled and count revenue only after USDC reaches the registered payout address.

Payment flow:

1. Call the endpoint with a ticker.
2. The endpoint returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and JSON body.
3. Send at least 0.001 SOL to the listed recipient address.
4. Include the required memo exactly, for example EdgarSnapshot:AAPL:<nonce>.
5. Retry with the same ticker and memo after confirmation.
6. If available, include the confirmed transaction signature as ?signature=<tx_signature> or in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

Discovery:

- API docs: https://secedgarterminal.com/paid-api
- OpenAPI: https://secedgarterminal.com/openapi.json
- Well-known metadata: https://secedgarterminal.com/.well-known/edgar-paid-api.json

Boundaries:

- Public SEC data only.
- No private data, login data, forecasts, trading recommendations, or investment advice.
- Payments are public on-chain transactions.
- For research and educational use only.
